req.title: Delete unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when DELETE targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a DELETE request to a non-existent task ID should return a 404 status code. This behavior needs to be verified through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system correctly identifies non-existent resources and responds with the appropriate error code.

tests.name: Delete existing task
preconditions: Task with ID 1 exists in the database
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Positive test: Delete an existing task
response = client.delete('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: Delete non-existent task
preconditions: Task with ID 999 does not exist in the database
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Negative test: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete('/tasks/999')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json() == {"detail": "Task with id 999 not found"}

tests.name: Delete task with boundary ID
preconditions: Task with ID 20 exists in the database
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Boundary test: Delete a task with the highest existing ID
response = client.delete('/tasks/20')
assert response.status_code == 204
